name: Occlusion-Aware Masking
aliases: Invisible Region Detection via Depth Warping
definition: A technique to generate a consistency mask $M_l$ that ignores regions with geometric inconsistencies (artifacts, self-occlusion) during feature-level regularization.
summary: Occlusion-Aware Masking identifies geometric inconsistencies by comparing rendered depth maps between views, distinguishing itself from methods relying on photometric differences.
